page.overview:
What is Flittle?

Flittle is small and resembles a chick. It is mostly yellow with with purple on its beak and small legs. It has a purple triangular mark on its forehead. It's body is frilly with two white frills on its head and two layers of frill wrapped around its waist. The second frill is pink in color. It also has green eyes with eyelashes.

Its frills allow it to levitate due to emitting psychic power, but only limited to half an inch off the ground.

Despite its appearance, it is known to be vengeful, especially to thieves that steal its berries.

Flittle evolves into Espathra starting at level 35.
